chunks: Ibrahim ibn Abi Ishaq al-Ahmari al-Nahawandi, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, and 'Amr ibn 'Uthman, and Muhammad ibn Khalid, and 'Abd Allah ibn al-Salt, and Muhammad ibn 'Isa, and a group also, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:
Al-Rida عليه السلام said: My father used to add, during the last ten nights of the month of Ramadan, twenty rak'ahs every night.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, referring to the father of Imam al-Rida عليه السلام
key_terms.الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Rida, the narrator of the report
key_terms.الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ: the last ten nights, a specially virtuous portion of Ramadan
key_terms.لَيْلَةٍ: a night; here, each night in the final ten

ai.seo_question: What did the father of Imam al-Rida عليه السلام do in the last ten nights of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام that his father increased his devotional prayer during the last ten nights of Ramadan. It highlights a practice of extra nightly salat in this blessed period and reflects the special devotional character of the final part of the month.
